title: Military Lending Act - covered borrowers
facts: The Military Lending Act provides special federal credit protections to covered active-duty servicemembers and certain dependents for covered consumer-credit products.
For covered transactions, the Military Annual Percentage Rate is generally capped at 36%.
The MLA also restricts certain contract terms and mandatory arbitration provisions in covered credit.
Whether a borrower and loan are covered requires applying the statutory and regulatory definitions.
